grammar.purpose: Give a direction without claiming arrival
grammar.explanation: 朝门口走 names the direction of movement; it does not say the person has already reached the doorway. Compare 搬到门口, which specifies the resulting location. 朝这里走 depends on the speaker’s position. Verify which entrance or stairway is intended before moving a heavy object.

examples.py: cháo zhè lǐ zǒu , xiān bié shàng lóu .
examples.en: Walk this way; do not go upstairs yet.

examples.py: bān dào mén kǒu , zài tíng xià .
examples.en: Move it to the doorway and then stop.

commonMistakes.wrong: 朝门口走了，所以已经到门口了。
commonMistakes.right: 朝门口走了，还没说是否到达。
commonMistakes.why: Direction of motion does not establish the endpoint.

grammar.pattern: 出来 / 出去 / 过来 / 过去 / 回来 / 回去 / 进来 / 进去 / 起来 / 上来 / 上去 / 下来 / 下去
grammar.explanation: 来 generally directs movement toward the reference speaker, 去 away. 我在二楼，你上来 contrasts with 我在一楼，你上去. 出/进 locate movement across a boundary, 回 indicates returning, 过 crossing toward or away from a point. 起来 can mean upward movement, not necessarily toward the speaker. With a location keep it before 来/去: 搬到门口来. Ask for the reference position when unclear; do not give dangerous lifting instructions.

examples.py: wǒ zài èr lóu , nǐ shàng lái .
examples.en: I am on the second floor; come up.

examples.py: wǒ zài yī lóu , nǐ xiān shàng qù .
examples.en: I am on the first floor; go up first.

examples.zh: 把轻箱子搬到门口来，再把工具拿进去。
examples.py: bǎ qīng xiāng zi bān dào mén kǒu lái , zài bǎ gōng jù ná jìn qù .
examples.en: Bring the light box to the doorway, then take the tools inside.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我在二楼，你从一楼下来找我。
commonMistakes.right: 我在二楼，你从一楼上来找我。
commonMistakes.why: Align upward or downward movement with the actual floors.

lines.zh: 你在哪儿？我把箱子搬到哪儿？
lines.py: nǐ zài nǎr ? wǒ bǎ xiāng zi bān dào nǎr ?
lines.en: Where are you? Where should I bring the box?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我在一楼门口，朝这边走。
lines.py: wǒ zài yī lóu mén kǒu , cháo zhè biān zǒu .
lines.en: At the entrance on the ground floor. Come this way.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 大的还是小的？
lines.py: dà de hái shi xiǎo de ?
lines.en: The big one or the small one?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先搬小的，里面是安装工具。
lines.py: xiān bān xiǎo de , lǐ miàn shì ān zhuāng gōng jù .
lines.en: Bring the small one first. It has the assembly tools inside.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 大的里面都是书，确实有点重。
lines.py: dà de lǐ miàn dōu shì shū , què shí yǒu diǎn zhòng .
lines.en: The big one's full of books. It really is heavy.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 放着吧，等我一起搬。先帮我推开门。
lines.py: fàng zhe ba , děng wǒ yì qǐ bān . xiān bāng wǒ tuī kāi mén .
lines.en: Leave it for now; we'll carry it together. Push the door open for me first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。工具拿进去以后，我上去吗？
lines.py: hǎo . gōng jù ná jìn qù yǐ hòu , wǒ shàng qù ma ?
lines.en: Okay. After taking the tools inside, should I go upstairs?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先在一楼等，桌子装好再把书搬上去。
lines.py: xiān zài yī lóu děng , zhuō zi zhuāng hǎo zài bǎ shū bān shàng qù .
lines.en: Wait on the ground floor first. We'll carry the books up when the desk is assembled.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我把小箱子放在门边那张旧桌子底下。
lines.py: nà wǒ bǎ xiǎo xiāng zi fàng zài mén biān nà zhāng jiù zhuō zi dǐ xià .
lines.en: I'll put the small box under the old table by the entrance, then.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，别放在门后面，开门会碰到。
lines.py: xíng , bié fàng zài mén hòu miàn , kāi mén huì pèng dào .
lines.en: Okay. Don't put it behind the door; the door will hit it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 知道了。你背上那个包要放下来吗？
lines.py: zhī dào le . nǐ bèi shàng nà gè bāo yào fàng xià lái ma ?
lines.en: Got it. Do you want to put down the bag on your back?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 当然，先帮我拿一下，我还没找到拉链。
lines.py: dāng rán , xiān bāng wǒ ná yī xià , wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào lā liàn .
lines.en: Yes. Hold it for a moment; I haven't found the zip yet.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: First the tools, then the furniture
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 今天林安搬家，我过去帮忙。到了楼下，她站在一楼门口，背着一个大包，朝我招手，让我先拿小箱子。
lines.py: jīn tiān lín ān bān jiā , wǒ guò qù bāng máng . dào le lóu xià , tā zhàn zài yī lóu mén kǒu , bēi zhe yī gè dà bāo , cháo wǒ zhāo shǒu , ràng wǒ xiān ná xiǎo xiāng zi .
lines.en: Lin An was moving today and I went to help. She stood by the ground-floor entrance with a big backpack, waving me over and asking me to take the small box first.

lines.zh: 小箱子里面是安装工具，大箱子里面都是书。我把工具拿进去，放在门边的旧桌子底下。书太重，等她放下包，我们再一起搬。
lines.py: xiǎo xiāng zi lǐ miàn shì ān zhuāng gōng jù , dà xiāng zi lǐ miàn dōu shì shū . wǒ bǎ gōng jù ná jìn qù , fàng zài mén biān de jiù zhuō zi dǐ xià . shū tài zhòng , děng tā fàng xià bāo , wǒ men zài yì qǐ bān .
lines.en: The small box held assembly tools; the big one held books. I took the tools inside and put them under the old table by the entrance. The books were heavy, so we'd carry them together after she put down her bag.

lines.zh: 林安把门推开，我看见里面还有两件新家具。一张木头桌子还没装好，旁边放着椅子。她说桌子是准备搬到二楼的。
lines.py: lín ān bǎ mén tuī kāi , wǒ kàn jiàn lǐ miàn hái yǒu liǎng jiàn xīn jiā jù . yī zhāng mù tou zhuō zi hái méi zhuāng hǎo , páng biān fàng zhe yǐ zi . tā shuō zhuō zi shì zhǔn bèi bān dào èr lóu de .
lines.en: Lin An pushed the door open. Inside were two new pieces of furniture: an unassembled wooden desk and a chair beside it. She said the desk was going upstairs.

lines.zh: 我们先把桌子装好，再一起抬上去。到了二楼，她把桌子放在朝南的窗边，我问书是不是也放这里，她说放在旁边的书架上。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān bǎ zhuō zi zhuāng hǎo , zài yì qǐ tái shàng qù . dào le èr lóu , tā bǎ zhuō zi fàng zài cháo nán de chuāng biān , wǒ wèn shū shì bú shì yě fàng zhè lǐ , tā shuō fàng zài páng biān de shū jià shàng .
lines.en: We assembled the desk and carried it up together. Upstairs she put it by the south-facing window. I asked about the books; they'd go on the bookshelf beside it.

lines.zh: 我下去拿书，她在楼上等。我拿了几本上来，放进书架，大箱子剩下的书就分几次拿，不再整箱搬。
lines.py: wǒ xià qù ná shū , tā zài lóu shàng děng . wǒ ná le jǐ běn shàng lái , fàng jìn shū jià , dà xiāng zi shèng xià de shū jiù fēn jǐ cì ná , bù zài zhěng xiāng bān .
lines.en: I went down for the books while she waited upstairs. I brought up a few and put them on the shelf. We made several trips for the rest rather than moving the whole box.

lines.zh: 全部放好以后，林安请我坐下喝水。我说椅子终于能用了，她笑着说今天最有用的家具，果然还是椅子。
lines.py: quán bù fàng hǎo yǐ hòu , lín ān qǐng wǒ zuò xià hē shuǐ . wǒ shuō yǐ zi zhōng yú néng yòng le , tā xiào zhe shuō jīn tiān zuì yǒu yòng de jiā jù , guǒ rán hái shi yǐ zi .
lines.en: When everything was in place Lin An offered me a seat and water. Finally a use for the chair, I said. She laughed that it really was today's most useful piece of furniture.

lines.py: bǎ zhè bǎ yǐ zi bān dào chuāng biān ba .
lines.en: Move this chair over to the window.

lines.zh: 箱子很重，两个人一起搬。
lines.py: xiāng zi hěn zhòng , liǎng gè rén yì qǐ bān .
lines.en: The box is heavy; two people should carry it together.

lines.zh: 我下周搬家。
lines.py: wǒ xià zhōu bān jiā .
lines.en: I'm moving home next week.

lines.zh: 搬家以后，我上班近多了。
lines.py: bān jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ shàng bān jìn duō le .
lines.en: My commute's much shorter after moving.

lines.zh: 他背着一个大包。
lines.py: tā bēi zhe yī gè dà bāo .
lines.en: He's carrying a large bag on his back.

lines.zh: 小时候，爸爸常背我回家。
lines.py: xiǎo shí hòu , bà bà cháng bēi wǒ huí jiā .
lines.en: Dad often carried me home on his back when I was little.

lines.zh: 你背后有一把椅子。
lines.py: nǐ bèi hòu yǒu yī bǎ yǐ zi .
lines.en: There's a chair behind you.

lines.zh: 她从我背后走过来。
lines.py: tā cóng wǒ bèi hòu zǒu guò lái .
lines.en: She came up from behind me.

lines.zh: 钥匙掉到桌子底下了。
lines.py: yào shi diào dào zhuō zi dǐ xià le .
lines.en: The keys fell under the table.

lines.zh: 椅子底下有一只猫。
lines.py: yǐ zi dǐ xià yǒu yī zhǐ māo .
lines.en: There's a cat under the chair.

lines.zh: 箱子里面都是书。
lines.py: xiāng zi lǐ miàn dōu shì shū .
lines.en: The box is full of books.

lines.zh: 你先进去，我在里面等。
lines.py: nǐ xiān jìn qù , wǒ zài lǐ miàn děng .
lines.en: Go in first. I'll wait inside.

lines.zh: 外面下雨了。
lines.py: wài miàn xià yǔ le .
lines.en: It's raining outside.

lines.zh: 我把自行车放在外面。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ zì xíng chē fàng zài wài miàn .
lines.en: I left my bicycle outside.

lines.zh: 把小盒子放在上面。
lines.py: bǎ xiǎo hé zi fàng zài shàng miàn .
lines.en: Put the small box on top.

lines.zh: 书上面还有一张纸。
lines.py: shū shàng miàn hái yǒu yī zhāng zhǐ .
lines.en: There's another sheet of paper on top of the book.

lines.zh: 大箱子放在下面吧。
lines.py: dà xiāng zi fàng zài xià miàn ba .
lines.en: Put the big box underneath.

lines.zh: 下面还有两个房间。
lines.py: xià miàn hái yǒu liǎng gè fáng jiān .
lines.en: There are two more rooms downstairs.

lines.zh: 前面就是车站。
lines.py: qián miàn jiù shì chē zhàn .
lines.en: The station's just ahead.

lines.zh: 坐在前面的人是我姐姐。
lines.py: zuò zài qián miàn de rén shì wǒ jiě jie .
lines.en: The person sitting in front is my sister.

lines.zh: 后面还有人，别关门。
lines.py: hòu miàn hái yǒu rén , bié guān mén .
lines.en: There are more people behind. Don't close the door.

lines.zh: 把这把椅子放在后面吧。
lines.py: bǎ zhè bǎ yǐ zi fàng zài hòu miàn ba .
lines.en: Put this chair at the back.

lines.zh: 我在二楼，你上来吧。
lines.py: wǒ zài èr lóu , nǐ shàng lái ba .
lines.en: I'm on the second floor. Come up.

lines.zh: 上来以后，先把包放下。
lines.py: shàng lái yǐ hòu , xiān bǎ bāo fàng xià .
lines.en: Put down your bag once you come up.

lines.zh: 他们先上去了，我在楼下等。
lines.py: tā men xiān shàng qù le , wǒ zài lóu xià děng .
lines.en: They went up first. I'll wait downstairs.

lines.zh: 这件家具太大，搬不上去。
lines.py: zhè jiàn jiā jù tài dà , bān bù shàng qù .
lines.en: This piece of furniture is too big to carry upstairs.

lines.zh: 你先下来，我们在门口等。
lines.py: nǐ xiān xià lái , wǒ men zài mén kǒu děng .
lines.en: Come down first; we're waiting at the entrance.

lines.zh: 他从楼上下来了。
lines.py: tā cóng lóu shàng xià lái le .
lines.en: He came down from upstairs.

lines.zh: 我要下去拿外卖。
lines.py: wǒ yào xià qù ná wài mài .
lines.en: I'm going downstairs to collect the food delivery.

lines.zh: 她带着空箱子下去了。
lines.py: tā dài zhe kōng xiāng zi xià qù le .
lines.en: She went downstairs with the empty box.

lines.zh: 这些家具由公司负责运输。
lines.py: zhè xiē jiā jù yóu gōng sī fù zé yùn shū .
lines.en: The company is responsible for transporting this furniture.

lines.zh: 运输过程中，箱子没有打开。
lines.py: yùn shū guò chéng zhōng , xiāng zi méi yǒu dǎ kāi .
lines.en: The box wasn't opened during transport.

lines.zh: 明天有人来安装空调。
lines.py: míng tiān yǒu rén lái ān zhuāng kōng tiáo .
lines.en: Someone's coming to install the air conditioner tomorrow.

lines.zh: 这张桌子还没安装好。
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhuō zi hái méi ān zhuāng hǎo .
lines.en: This desk hasn't been assembled yet.

lines.zh: 房间里的家具都是旧的。
lines.py: fáng jiān lǐ de jiā jù dōu shì jiù de .
lines.en: All the furniture in the room is old.

lines.zh: 我们周末去买家具。
lines.py: wǒ men zhōu mò qù mǎi jiā jù .
lines.en: We're buying furniture at the weekend.

lines.zh: 修自行车需要什么工具？
lines.py: xiū zì xíng chē xū yào shén me gōng jù ?
lines.en: What tools do we need to fix a bicycle?

lines.zh: 工具放在小箱子里。
lines.py: gōng jù fàng zài xiǎo xiāng zi lǐ .
lines.en: The tools are in the small box.

lines.zh: 这张桌子是木头做的。
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhuō zi shì mù tou zuò de .
lines.en: This table is made of wood.

lines.zh: 门口放着两块木头。
lines.py: mén kǒu fàng zhe liǎng kuài mù tou .
lines.en: There are two pieces of wood by the entrance.

lines.zh: 把门推开，我拿着东西。
lines.py: bǎ mén tuī kāi , wǒ ná zhe dōng xi .
lines.en: Push the door open; my hands are full.

lines.zh: 他轻轻推开窗户。
lines.py: tā qīng qīng tuī kāi chuāng hù .
lines.en: He gently pushed the window open.

audio.zh: 先搬小的，里面是安装工具。
audio.py: xiān bān xiǎo de , lǐ miàn shì ān zhuāng gōng jù .
audio.en: Bring the small one first. It has the assembly tools inside.

audio.zh: 全部放好以后，林安请我坐下喝水。我说椅子终于能用了，她笑着说今天最有用的家具，果然还是椅子。
audio.py: quán bù fàng hǎo yǐ hòu , lín ān qǐng wǒ zuò xià hē shuǐ . wǒ shuō yǐ zi zhōng yú néng yòng le , tā xiào zhe shuō jīn tiān zuì yǒu yòng de jiā jù , guǒ rán hái shi yǐ zi .
audio.en: When everything was in place Lin An offered me a seat and water. Finally a use for the chair, I said. She laughed that it really was today's most useful piece of furniture.

2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Replaced policy-like lines with rainy-day lunch and muddy-shoe teasing, a wrong-date mix-up, student-union registration and travel photos, and a move with tools, a desk and books. All 88 existing vocabulary IDs get two independent contexts; tasks and grammar ownership preserved. Self-review: class rules out morning, lunch around two, walk after three; old cancellation image and current second-floor seven-o’clock show; four classmates, one representative, two-minute talk, host Xiao Zhou; small box tools, large box books, desk assembled below then carried up, narrator goes down and comes back up. False listening statements contradict their own clip.
